notesZh:
组网：
- 新增「伪装入口」：手机、电脑经一层加密伪装连回家里（默认 UDP 30000），外网看到的不再是普通的 WireGuard 流量；在主路由上把这个端口转发到本路由器即可。
- 每台组网设备有独立的入口密码，删除或到期后立即失效；面板显示证书指纹，App 连接时会核对。
- 设备的分享链接和二维码带上伪装入口信息，用新版 App 重新导入即改走伪装入口；旧版 App 和其他 WireGuard 软件仍按原端口直连。
- 新增「访问范围」：拨入的设备默认只能访问路由器本身和你勾选的局域网设备；设备之间能否互相访问可单独开启，也可一键「全部放开」。
- 每台设备可以设置自己的访问范围，只按它自己的清单放行。
- 开启伪装入口后，「端口」页只在最近 7 天内仍有设备直连时才显示 WireGuard 直连一行。
网关：
- 新增顶部菜单「网关」，集中放置把家里服务发布到外网的设置：动态域名、端口、反向代理、证书、访问账号、监测。
- 动态域名支持阿里云解析和 Cloudflare，可维护 @（域名本身）、*（所有子域名）和其他主机记录；每 5 分钟检查一次家里的外网 IP，变了才更新解析，查 IP 时不经过代理。
- 自动识别本路由器是主路由还是旁路由，显示在状态栏；识别不对时可在设置里固定。
- 作为旁路由时，主路由开了 UPnP 就自动申请所需端口；没开时「端口」页提示需要手动转发。
- 新增「反向代理」：用自己的域名把家里的网页服务发布到外网，支持批量导入网站。
- 新增「证书」：自动申请免费证书，包含域名本身和所有一级子域名，用动态域名的账号做 DNS 验证，到期前 30 天自动续签。
- 新增「TLS 转发」（在「端口」页）：给非网页服务用，在本机端口用证书解开 TLS 后转给家里的设备。
登录与账号：
- 新增 EdgeNest 登录页：同一域名下的网站登录一次即可通用；可选记住 1 天、7 天、30 天，或关掉浏览器就要重新登录；同一地址连续输错 5 次锁定 15 分钟。
- 新增「访问账号」：每个网站可选只允许哪些账号访问；账号可开启两步验证。
- 每个网站可选访问方式：EdgeNest 登录页、浏览器弹窗（给手机 App / 程序调用）或不需要登录。
局域网共享与文件夹：
- 新增局域网共享挂载向导：自动扫描局域网里的 Windows 共享和 Linux 共享，选设备、选共享即可挂载，不用敲命令。
- 挂好的共享在路由器开机后自动挂上；对方设备重启掉线后也会自动重新挂。
- 新网站类型「发布文件夹」：图形化选择要发布的文件夹或单个文件，默认只读，可选允许上传；只读挂载的共享不能开启上传。
监测与提醒：
- 新增「监测」：反向代理里启用的网站自动每分钟检查一次；也可以手动添加网址、端口或 Ping 检查。
- 公网网址显示证书剩余天数，30 天内到期每天提醒一次。
- 掉线、恢复、证书快到期都会经 Bark 推送到手机；每一项可以单独设为不推送。
- 连续 2 次连不上才算掉线；30 分钟内断开超过 3 次只推一条「不稳定」，稳定后再推。
- 路由器重启后，本来就掉线的服务不会再重复提醒。
- 新网站类型「家庭首页」：用方块列出所有网站和在线状态，必须登录才能访问。
其他：
- 网关页的每个报错都有清楚的说明（跟随面板语言），并显示在当前打开的弹窗里。
- 在弹窗里拖选文字、松开时鼠标在弹窗外，弹窗不再被关掉。
- 规则页和组网页改为分页布局，面板加宽。
- 广告拦截和按域名的拦截规则每次都会立即拒绝连接，不会在频繁命中后变成没有回应，App 不再因此卡住等待。
- 内置规则更新到 11 月 1 日。
notesEn:
Mesh:
- New Disguised entry: phones and computers reach home through an encrypted, disguised layer (UDP 30000 by default), so the outside no longer sees plain WireGuard traffic; forward this port on your main router to this router.
- Each mesh device gets its own entry password, which stops working as soon as the device is removed or expires; the panel shows the certificate fingerprint, and the app checks it when connecting.
- Device share links and QR codes now carry the disguised entry details; re-import with the new app to switch over, while older apps and other WireGuard apps keep connecting on the original port.
- New Access tab: dialled-in devices can by default reach only the router itself and the LAN devices you tick; letting them reach each other is a separate switch, and Open all lifts the limit in one step.
- Each device can have its own access range and is let through only to the devices on its own list.
- With the disguised entry on, the Ports tab shows the WireGuard direct row only while a device has connected directly in the last 7 days.
Gateway:
- New Gateway top menu that gathers what you need to publish home services to the internet: Dynamic DNS, Ports, Reverse proxy, Certificates, Accounts and Monitor.
- Dynamic DNS supports Aliyun DNS and Cloudflare, for @ (the domain itself), * (every subdomain) and other host records; the home public IP is checked every 5 minutes, records change only when it changes, and the check bypasses the proxy.
- Detects whether this router is the main router or a side router and shows it in the status bar; if detection is wrong, set it in Settings.
- As a side router, ports are requested automatically when the main router has UPnP on; otherwise the Ports tab shows which ports to forward by hand.
- New Reverse proxy: publish web services at home under your own domain, with bulk import of sites.
- New Certificates: free certificates requested automatically, covering the domain itself and every first-level subdomain, checked through your dynamic DNS account and renewed 30 days before expiry.
- New TLS forwards (on the Ports tab): for non-web services, TLS is removed on a local port with the certificate and the stream passed to a device at home.
Login and accounts:
- New EdgeNest login page: one sign-in covers the sites under the same domain; stay signed in for 1, 7 or 30 days, or until the browser closes; 5 wrong tries from one address lock it for 15 minutes.
- New Accounts tab: each site can be limited to chosen accounts, and accounts can turn on 2-step verification.
- Each site picks how visitors get in: the EdgeNest login page, a browser dialog (for mobile apps / API clients), or no login.
LAN shares and folders:
- New LAN share mount wizard: scans the LAN for Windows and Linux shares; pick a device and a share to mount it, no commands needed.
- Mounted shares come back automatically after the router starts, and remount on their own when the other device restarts or drops off.
- New site type Publish a folder: pick a folder or a single file to publish; read-only by default, with uploads as an option; uploads cannot be turned on for a share mounted read-only.
Monitoring and alerts:
- New Monitor tab: sites enabled under Reverse proxy are checked every minute automatically, and you can add URL, port or Ping checks by hand.
- Public URLs show how many days their certificate has left, with a daily reminder within 30 days of expiry.
- Outages, recoveries and expiring certificates are pushed to your phone via Bark; any single check can be set to no alerts.
- A service counts as down only after 2 failed checks in a row; more than 3 drops within 30 minutes send a single "unstable" alert, and the next one waits until it settles.
- After the router restarts, services that were already down are not reported again.
- New site type Home page: tiles for every site with its online status; sign-in required.
Other:
- Every error on the Gateway page comes with a clear explanation in the panel language, shown inside the open dialog.
- A dialog no longer closes when you drag to select text and release the mouse outside it.
- The Rules and Mesh pages now use tabbed layouts, and the panel is wider.
- Ad blocking and domain-based block rules now refuse every connection right away instead of going silent after many hits, so apps no longer hang waiting.
- Built-in rules updated to November 1.
